name: rea-shim
description: Unofficial one-line shortcut to Craft Anything on Windows x64. Starts the desktop app with no flag, or serves an MCP JSON-RPC channel with --mcp. Verifies a pinned portable release before use. Ships no upstream code. All credit to the Craft Anything authors.

scripts.check: node --check bin/rea-shim.js && node --check lib/craft.js && node --check lib/settings.js && node --check lib/sources.js && node --check lib/support.js

author: nathwn12
